answer: Continuous Presence Windows. Each identity must publish unpredictable micro-tasks answered live within randomly scheduled windows; missed windows decay its standing like a glacier retreating. Verification requires solving a fresh challenge whose latency is benchmarked against a sonnet-length baseline of prior responses, so copied answers fail timing checks. An attacker pays sustained synchronized attention per identity, and that attention cost compounds across accounts, forming a crystal-hard barrier against mass fabrication.
